chats.title: NVivo coding help
chats.user: hey, I'm trying to code interview transcripts in NVivo for my RA job and I keep messing up the hierarchy. is there a way to merge two codes without losing the references?
chats.gist: Explained how to merge codes in NVivo by right-clicking the code and selecting Merge, and warned that child codes get absorbed into the parent.

chats.title: React form validation
chats.user: ok so I'm building a volunteer signup form for a nonprofit and I need to validate email + phone before submit. what's the cleanest way in React?
chats.gist: Suggested using react-hook-form with zod for schema validation, and gave a small code snippet for email/phone rules.

chats.title: Gift ideas for dad
chats.user: my dad's birthday is coming up and he's impossible to shop for. he likes fishing and woodworking and also he's a huge nerd about old radios. any gift ideas under $100?
chats.gist: Brainstormed a list: personalized tackle box, vintage radio restoration kit, woodworking tool set, and a subscription to a fishing magazine.

chats.title: Moderated vs unmoderated usability testing
chats.user: for our HCI group project we're debating whether to do moderated or unmoderated usability testing. we have like 2 weeks and a small budget. what do you think?
chats.gist: Compared trade-offs: moderated gives richer qualitative data but takes longer; unmoderated is faster and cheaper but less depth. Suggested a hybrid if possible.

chats.title: Firebase timestamp timezone bug
chats.user: ugh, the event dates on my nonprofit web app are showing wrong times. I stored them as ISO strings but they're off by 5 hours. is this a timezone thing?
chats.gist: Explained that ISO strings without timezone are treated as local time by JS Date, and recommended storing UTC or using a library like date-fns-tz.

chats.title: How to stop getting distracted
chats.user: I literally cannot focus today. I've been 'working' for 3 hours and all I've done is read reddit and listen to lofi. how do you force yourself to start?
chats.gist: Suggested the 5-minute rule, blocking distracting sites with a browser extension, and breaking tasks into tiny physical actions like opening the doc first.

chats.title: Netlify deploy issue
chats.user: my React app builds fine locally but the Netlify deploy keeps failing with 'Plugin failed to install'. I'm so confused. help?
chats.gist: Walked through checking the build command and Node version in Netlify settings, and suggested clearing the build cache or pinning the plugin version.

chats.title: INFO 6501 vs INFO 6502
chats.user: trying to pick electives for next semester. Data Visualization vs Critical AI Ethics. I like making pretty charts but also I care about ethics. which one is more useful for an info science career?
chats.gist: Gave a balanced take: Data Viz is more immediately marketable, AI Ethics is more discussion-based and good for critical thinking; suggested checking the syllabus and professor reviews.

chats.title: Writing a methods section
chats.user: I have to write a methods section for our usability study and I'm staring at a blank doc. how do I structure it? we did 5 moderated sessions and 8 unmoderated.
chats.gist: Outlined a standard methods structure: participants, apparatus, procedure, and analysis, with tips on reporting session counts and moderation details.

chats.title: Etsy seller shipping question
chats.user: I'm about to order a personalized gift from Etsy but the seller says it takes 2-3 weeks to make. is that normal? I need it by next week.
chats.gist: Said 2-3 weeks is normal for personalized items, and suggested messaging the seller to ask about rush options or checking if they have a faster shipping upgrade.

chats.title: Qualitative coding theme definitions
chats.user: my lab PI said to code for 'community trust' but I'm not sure what counts. is it just when people say they trust someone, or also when they describe actions that imply trust?
chats.gist: Suggested coding both explicit statements and behavioral indicators, and recommended creating a codebook with inclusion/exclusion examples to stay consistent.

chats.title: Slack bot for group project reminders
chats.user: my group project teammates keep forgetting to do their parts. I want to set up a Slack reminder bot but I don't want to be the annoying one. is it worth it?
chats.gist: Suggested using Slack's built-in /remind command instead of a bot, and framing reminders as 'checking in' rather than nagging to keep the vibe positive.

chats.title: Invoice template for freelance work
chats.user: I need to send an invoice to the nonprofit for my web app work. I quoted $350 but I added an extra admin page so I want to charge $400. how do I word that?
chats.gist: Recommended itemizing the original scope and the additional admin page as a separate line item, and including a note that the extra was approved via email.

chats.title: RateMyProfessors is scaring me
chats.user: I just looked up the professor for Critical AI Ethics and the reviews are so mixed. some people say she's brilliant, others say she's disorganized and grades harshly. should I switch back to Data Viz?
chats.gist: Advised not to over-index on RateMyProfessors, suggested checking the syllabus and talking to the department, and noted that mixed reviews often mean a challenging but rewarding class.

chats.title: Last-minute gift panic
chats.user: ok I finally ordered the tackle box for my dad but now I'm second-guessing. is a personalized tackle box actually a good gift or is it too cheesy?
chats.gist: Reassured that personalized gifts are thoughtful and practical, and suggested adding a handwritten note to make it feel more personal.

chats.title: How to ask for a deadline extension
chats.user: I'm supposed to finish coding transcripts for the lab by Friday but I'm only halfway through. how do I email my PI without sounding like I'm slacking?
chats.gist: Drafted a short email that acknowledges the delay, explains the specific bottleneck, and proposes a concrete revised deadline with a plan to finish.
